dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's wrong with being a sailor?

dialogues.speaker: Lindemann
dialogues.text: Well, nothing... It's just that over the past few years, there's been a young sailor who's been drifting from Yilong Wharf to Port Belovodye, toying with girls' hearts in every single port of call.

dialogues.speaker: Lindemann
dialogues.text: I can't recall the scoundrel's name. But think about it! Could an ordinary sailor possibly have stolen my daughter's heart so?

dialogues.speaker: Lindemann
dialogues.text: For the sake of Irmgard's happiness, I have to keep a close eye on the company she keeps...
